name: image-to-prompt
title_zh: 把参考图逆向成可复用的中英双语绘图提示词
tagline_zh: 看到一张好图，却说不清它好在哪？给它喂图，它替你拆解光线、构图、风格，输出能直接粘贴的提示词，中英双语各一份。
tagline_en: Stuck on how to describe a great image? Feed it a picture, get back a ready-to-paste prompt—lighting.
desc_en: Analyze one or more reference images and reconstruct faithful, reusable image-generation prompts in Chinese and English. Use when users want to reverse-engineer, infer, restore, imitate, or write prompts from visual references.
why_zh: 不是简单打标签，而是按生成模型习惯重排描述顺序，并区分『可复现要素』与『风格猜测』。
why_en: It doesn't just tag—it reorders descriptions the way diffusion models expect, and separates reproducible elements from stylistic.
limit_zh: 只认单张或少量参考图，不处理视频帧序列；输出是提示词文本，不负责调参或生成图像；对抽象艺术、超现实拼贴的还原度低。
limit_en: Single or few still images only, no video frames. Output is prompt text, not tuned params or generated images. Abstract/surreal collages degrade.
